problem: A transversal across parallel lines gives equal alternate angles, equal corresponding exterior/interior angles and same-side interior angle sum pi.

proof_idea.original: Use the parallel postulate to exclude unequal alternate angles, then vertical-angle equality and straight-angle sums.
proof_idea.analytic: Derive a strictly negative direction scale from real-coordinate parallelism and the opposite-side positions. Both ray reversals preserve the alternate cosine. Further opposite-ray scales produce the corresponding equality and supplementary sum.

# Book I.29: a transversal of parallel lines gives equal alternate angles,
# equal corresponding exterior/interior angles, and same-side interior sum pi.
# c and x are the opposite first-line and transversal rays, with positive
# scale parameters recording their source positions. The real-plane proof
# derives a negative parallel-ray scale, then preserves normalized cosines.
thm proposition_29:
    ? forall p, q, a, b, c, x cart(R, R), r, s R+:
        p != q
        p != a
        q != b
        p != c
        p != x
        $parallel::are_parallel_lines(p, a, q, b)
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, q), geometry::main::vec(p, a))*geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, q), geometry::main::vec(q, b)) < 0
        c(1)-p(1) = -s*(a(1)-p(1))
        c(2)-p(2) = -s*(a(2)-p(2))
        x(1)-p(1) = -r*(q(1)-p(1))
        x(2)-p(2) = -r*(q(2)-p(2))
        =>:
            $geometry::main::are_angles_congruent(a, p, q, p, q, b)
            $geometry::main::are_angles_congruent(x, p, c, p, q, b)
            angle_measure::ray_angle(c, p, q)+angle_measure::ray_angle(p, q, b) = pi
    by def $parallel::are_parallel_lines(p, a, q, b)
    by def $geometry::main::is_parallel(p, a, q, b)
    have ux R = a(1)-p(1)
    have uy R = a(2)-p(2)
    have vx R = b(1)-q(1)
    have vy R = b(2)-q(2)
    have wx R = q(1)-p(1)
    have wy R = q(2)-p(2)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_positive_of_ne(p, a)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(p, a)
    have norm R+ = geometry::main::distance_sq(p, a)
    norm = (a(1)-p(1))^2+(a(2)-p(2))^2 = ux^2+uy^2
    release thm geometry::main::vec_coordinate_formula(p, a)
    release thm geometry::main::vec_coordinate_formula(q, b)
    release thm geometry::main::vec_coordinate_formula(p, q)
    geometry::main::vec(p, a)(1) = a(1)-p(1) = ux
    geometry::main::vec(p, a)(2) = a(2)-p(2) = uy
    geometry::main::vec(q, b)(1) = b(1)-q(1) = vx
    geometry::main::vec(q, b)(2) = b(2)-q(2) = vy
    geometry::main::vec(p, q)(1) = q(1)-p(1) = wx
    geometry::main::vec(p, q)(2) = q(2)-p(2) = wy
    release thm geometry::main::det_coordinate_formula(geometry::main::vec(p, a), geometry::main::vec(q, b))
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, a), geometry::main::vec(q, b)) = ux*vy-uy*vx = 0
    have projection R = ux*vx+uy*vy
    norm*vx = (ux^2+uy^2)*vx = ux*(ux*vx+uy*vy)-uy*(ux*vy-uy*vx) = ux*projection-uy*0 = ux*projection
    norm*vy = (ux^2+uy^2)*vy = uy*(ux*vx+uy*vy)+ux*(ux*vy-uy*vx) = uy*projection+ux*0 = uy*projection
    have ratio R = projection/norm
    ratio*ux = (projection/norm)*ux = (ux*projection)/norm
    vx = (norm*vx)/norm = (ux*projection)/norm
    vx = ratio*ux
    ratio*uy = (projection/norm)*uy = (uy*projection)/norm
    vy = (norm*vy)/norm = (uy*projection)/norm
    vy = ratio*uy
    have d1 R = wx*uy-wy*ux
    have d2 R = wx*vy-wy*vx
    release thm geometry::main::det_coordinate_formula(geometry::main::vec(p, q), geometry::main::vec(p, a))
    release thm geometry::main::det_coordinate_formula(geometry::main::vec(p, q), geometry::main::vec(q, b))
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, q), geometry::main::vec(p, a)) = wx*uy-wy*ux = d1
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, q), geometry::main::vec(q, b)) = wx*vy-wy*vx = d2
    d1*d2 = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, q), geometry::main::vec(p, a))*geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(p, q), geometry::main::vec(q, b)) < 0
    d2 = wx*vy-wy*vx = wx*(ratio*uy)-wy*(ratio*ux) = ratio*(wx*uy-wy*ux) = ratio*d1
    ratio*d1^2 = d1*(ratio*d1) = d1*d2 < 0
    by contra:
        ? ratio < 0
        ratio >= 0
        d1^2 >= 0
        ratio*d1^2 >= 0
        impossible ratio*d1^2 < 0
    -ratio > 0
    have k R+ = -ratio
    -k = -(-ratio) = ratio
    -k*(a(1)-p(1)) = ratio*ux = vx
    b(1)-q(1) = vx = -k*(a(1)-p(1))
    -k*(a(2)-p(2)) = ratio*uy = vy
    b(2)-q(2) = vy = -k*(a(2)-p(2))
    release thm angles::angle_den_positive(a, p, q)
    release thm angles::angle_den_nonnegative(a, p, q)
    release thm angles::angle_den_nonnegative(p, q, b)
    have den R+ = geometry::main::angle_cos_den(a, p, q)
    have root R+ = sqrt(den)
    have numerator R = geometry::main::angle_cos_num(a, p, q)
    release thm geometry::main::perpendicular_dot_expand(p, a, p, q)
    release thm geometry::main::perpendicular_dot_expand(q, p, q, b)
    geometry::main::angle_cos_num(a, p, q) = geometry::main::dot(geometry::main::vec(p, a), geometry::main::vec(p, q))
    geometry::main::dot(geometry::main::vec(p, a), geometry::main::vec(p, q)) = (a(1)-p(1))*(q(1)-p(1))+(a(2)-p(2))*(q(2)-p(2))
    numerator = geometry::main::angle_cos_num(a, p, q) = (a(1)-p(1))*(q(1)-p(1))+(a(2)-p(2))*(q(2)-p(2))
    p(1)-q(1) = -(q(1)-p(1))
    p(2)-q(2) = -(q(2)-p(2))
    geometry::main::angle_cos_num(p, q, b) = geometry::main::dot(geometry::main::vec(q, p), geometry::main::vec(q, b)) = (p(1)-q(1))*(b(1)-q(1))+(p(2)-q(2))*(b(2)-q(2))
    (p(1)-q(1))*(b(1)-q(1))+(p(2)-q(2))*(b(2)-q(2)) = (-(q(1)-p(1)))*(-k*(a(1)-p(1)))+(-(q(2)-p(2)))*(-k*(a(2)-p(2))) = k*((a(1)-p(1))*(q(1)-p(1))+(a(2)-p(2))*(q(2)-p(2))) = k*numerator
    geometry::main::angle_cos_num(p, q, b) = k*numerator
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(q, b)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_coordinate_formula(p, a)
    geometry::main::distance_sq(q, b) = (b(1)-q(1))^2+(b(2)-q(2))^2 = (-k*(a(1)-p(1)))^2+(-k*(a(2)-p(2)))^2 = k^2*((a(1)-p(1))^2+(a(2)-p(2))^2) = k^2*geometry::main::distance_sq(p, a)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_symmetric(p, q)
    geometry::main::distance_sq(q, p) = geometry::main::distance_sq(p, q)
    den = geometry::main::angle_cos_den(a, p, q) = geometry::main::distance_sq(p, a)*geometry::main::distance_sq(p, q)
    geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, b) = geometry::main::distance_sq(q, p)*geometry::main::distance_sq(q, b)
    geometry::main::distance_sq(q, p)*geometry::main::distance_sq(q, b) = geometry::main::distance_sq(p, q)*(k^2*geometry::main::distance_sq(p, a))
    geometry::main::distance_sq(p, q)*(k^2*geometry::main::distance_sq(p, a)) = k^2*(geometry::main::distance_sq(p, a)*geometry::main::distance_sq(p, q)) = k^2*den
    geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, b) = k^2*den
    release thm angle_measure::scaled_positive_root_domain(k, den)
    sqrt(geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, b)) = sqrt(k^2*den) = sqrt(k^2)*sqrt(den) = |k|*root = k*root
    sqrt(geometry::main::angle_cos_den(a, p, q)) = sqrt(den) = root
    angles::angle_cosine(a, p, q) = geometry::main::angle_cos_num(a, p, q)/sqrt(geometry::main::angle_cos_den(a, p, q)) = numerator/root
    angles::angle_cosine(p, q, b) = geometry::main::angle_cos_num(p, q, b)/sqrt(geometry::main::angle_cos_den(p, q, b)) = (k*numerator)/(k*root) = numerator/root
    release thm angle_measure::equal_cosines_imply_angle_relation(a, p, q, p, q, b)
    release thm angle_measure::negative_ray_scale_changes_cosine_sign(q, p, a, c, s)
    release thm angle_measure::angle_cosine_arms_symmetric(c, p, q)
    release thm angle_measure::angle_cosine_arms_symmetric(a, p, q)
    angles::angle_cosine(c, p, q) = angles::angle_cosine(q, p, c) = -angles::angle_cosine(q, p, a) = -angles::angle_cosine(a, p, q) = -angles::angle_cosine(p, q, b)
    release thm angle_measure::negative_ray_scale_changes_cosine_sign(c, p, q, x, r)
    release thm angle_measure::angle_cosine_arms_symmetric(x, p, c)
    angles::angle_cosine(x, p, c) = angles::angle_cosine(c, p, x) = -angles::angle_cosine(c, p, q) = -(-angles::angle_cosine(a, p, q)) = angles::angle_cosine(a, p, q) = angles::angle_cosine(p, q, b)
    release thm angle_measure::equal_cosines_imply_angle_relation(x, p, c, p, q, b)
    angles::angle_cosine(p, q, b) = -(-angles::angle_cosine(p, q, b)) = -angles::angle_cosine(c, p, q)
    release thm angle_measure::opposite_cosines_give_supplementary_angles(c, p, q, p, q, b)
